description: Create a new, empty document for the signed-in user in one of the builders. Returns the new id and version. Pass spaceId to start it inside a shared Space the user can edit; without it the document is personal. Pass idempotencyKey and a repeat of the same call returns the document it already made rather than a second one. Give the reader the returned url: it opens the document in its builder.

idempotencyKey.description: Your id for this create. Repeating it returns the same document instead of making two.

spaceId.description: A shared Space to start the document in. The user must be its owner or an editor.

title.description: Defaults to the builder's own default.

toolKey.description: Which builder: ost | usm | cfd | vsm | noice | wardley | roi | roadmap.

name: tools_create_document
title: Create a tool document
